A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 28-page versions of the same work. Their text, equations, figures, tables and full appendices support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original estimator evaluations and model fine-tuning results in Section 4 and Table 1, with additional empirical comparisons in Appendices A.5–A.6.

after.justification: v4 retains these original estimator evaluations, fine-tuning results and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Both retain the same harmonic-number and logarithmic plug-in estimators and fine-tuning objectives. Equation (12) corrects an intermediate expression to match the computational formula already present in v3, without introducing a procedural revision.

E1.justification: Both evaluate image classification on CIFAR10/100 and ImageNet and review-rating prediction on Amazon Reviews. Dataset, task and appendix evaluation coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: SELE and 2×SELE retain the same participation in estimator comparisons, as do CE and SELE in the Table 1 fine-tuning comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 4 retains the same models, losses, test-set batching, confidence-score comparisons and fine-tuning settings, including 30 epochs and batch size 128. No evaluation protocol revision is reported.

E4.justification: The sample-size bias, MAE and MSE analyses, confidence-score sensitivity comparisons and empirical equivalence check in Appendix A.5 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the same five-seed fine-tuning summaries, five-model MAE summaries, batch-based variability reporting and Appendix A.5 two-sided t-tests.

E6.justification: Table 1 and all main-text and appendix result figures retain identical entries, values, curves and findings. No empirical results are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: Equation (12) removes an erroneous 1/n multiplying the denominator sum. This fixes a factor-n discrepancy with its unchanged harmonic-sum right-hand side and the harmonic-number formula in Equation (13). Other derivations, propositions and appendix proofs remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about population AURC as reweighted risk, consistent plug-in estimators, convergence rates and usefulness for fine-tuning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of estimator bias, variance, SELE behavior and confidence-score effects are unchanged. The fixed-model scope, Bayesian extension and discussion of distribution shift and class imbalance are also retained.

D1.justification: Code-access information, model sources, batch sizes, learning rate and training duration are unchanged. No implementation or reproducibility details are added or removed.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works and positioning relative to SELE and other selective-classification metrics remain unchanged.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v3 dated 28 May 2025 to v4 dated 3 September 2025. The prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The shorter Equation (12) brings its equation number onto the same line and slightly reflows surrounding text on page 4. All figure and table displays, including appendix panels, remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 removes the spurious normalization factor in Equation (12), making its indicator-sum expression agree with the harmonic-number estimator already given in v3. This resolves a localized mathematical inconsistency and improves the derivation's reliability, while the broader theory, empirical evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
